about: Known, argued differences between HydraDB's recorded answer for a parity
matrix row and what Neo4j returns for the same query on the same graph.
Read by query-language/cypher/scripts/neo4j_parity_oracle.py. A listed row may differ from Neo4j;
an unlisted row may not. A listed row that agrees with Neo4j again fails
the run, so an entry cannot outlive the difference it excuses.
Each entry names the row, the kind of difference (semantics, type,
ordering, error), why HydraDB keeps it, and who reviewed that reasoning.
